# Great! The cycle is confirmed: each position gets color from position (i+1) mod 20
# Path order: top L→R (0-6), right T→B (7-9), bottom R→L (10-16), left B→T (17-19)

# First, let me see the current state

nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find all colored 16px blocks
colored_blocks = []
for n in nodes:
    if n['pixels'] == 16 and n['color'] not in ('B', 'c'):
        b = n['boundary']

        center_c = min_c + 2

print("=== Colored blocks ===")
for bid, color, r, c in colored_blocks:
    print(f"  {bid}: {color} at ({r},{c})")

# Let me try clicking on a colored block instead of the red agent
# Try clicking on the top-left block (currently S at position 0)
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 20, 'col': 13}])
print(f"\nClick on block result: {result['board_changed']}, gameplay_changed: {result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Check what changed
if result['board_changed']:
    before_a = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    after_a = last_transition.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for i in range(15, 51):
        if before_a[i] != after_a[i]:
            print(f"Row {i} changed")
